en: Jeremiah 1

p.src: 1  The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

en: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
u.src: 1  The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

p.src: 2  The LORD’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

ja: であるユダの王ヨシヤの
en: The LORD’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
u.src: 2  The LORD’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

ja: 1:2 すべて大文字の「主」または「神」はヘブル語のיהוה（ヤハウェ）から来ている。ただし、短い形のיה（ヤハ）から来ていると記されている場合を除く。
en: 1:2 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 3  It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

ja: 主の言葉はまた、ヨシヤの
であるユダの王エホヤキムの
にも彼に臨み、ヨシヤの
であるユダの王ゼデキヤの治世
わり、すなわちエルサレムが
として連れ去られた第五の月まで
en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
u.src: 3  It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

p.src: 4  Now the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

en: Now the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
u.src: 4  Now the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

p.src: 5  “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

ja: っていた。 あなたが生まれる
en: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
u.src: 5  “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

p.src: 6  Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

en: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
u.src: 6  Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

ja:
1:6 「主」と訳された言葉は「アドナイ」である。
1:6 「見よ」はヘブル語のהִנֵּהに由来し、「見なさい」「注目しなさい」などの意味を持つ間投詞である。
en:
1:6 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”
1:6 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 7  But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.

ja: われた。「『私はまだ子どもです』と
ってはならない。わたしがあなたを
のところへ行き、わたしが
じることをすべて語りなさい。
en: But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.
u.src: 7  But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.

p.src: 8  Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.

ja: れてはならない。わたしがあなたとともにいて、あなたを
すからだ」と、主は言われる。
en: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.
u.src: 8  Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.

p.src: 9  Then the LORD stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

ja: よ、わたしの言葉をあなたの
en: Then the LORD stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
u.src: 9  Then the LORD stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

p.src: 10  Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

en: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
u.src: 10  Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

p.src: 11  Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”

ja: み、こう告げられた。「エレミヤ、
は言った。「アーモンドの木の
en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
u.src: 11  Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”

p.src: 12  Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”

ja: げるため、それを見守っているからだ。」
en: Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”
u.src: 12  Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”

p.src: 13  The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”

en: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”
u.src: 13  The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”

p.src: 14  Then the LORD said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

en: Then the LORD said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.
u.src: 14  Then the LORD said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

p.src: 15  For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says the LORD. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

ja: 見よ、わたしは北の王国のすべての諸族を呼び寄せる」と、
en: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says the LORD. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.
u.src: 15  For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says the LORD. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

p.src: 16  I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

ja: について、彼らに対する
en: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.
u.src: 16  I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

p.src: 17  “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.

ja: らの前でうろたえてはならない。さもなければ、わたしが
であなたをうろたえさせる。
en: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.
u.src: 17  “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.

p.src: 18  For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

ja: よ、今日、わたしはあなたをこの国全体に立ち向かう城塞都市、
en: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
u.src: 18  For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
